facts.meaning: FIELD_EFFECTS captures MAX_MONEY as PayDay editor maximum when module body is evaluated. DebugSetEffects field mode takes battle.field.effects by reference; integer editor uses metadata max or99, min ordefault0. USE invokes number selection; ACTION resets0, LEFT/RIGHT move one within respective comparisons. Cancel from chooser returns its configured original/default per separately received number contract.
facts.control: This constrains this debug input path, not actual prize computation. Existing out-of-range effect values are not automatically clamped by constructing the menu; RIGHT does nothing when already>=max. Module constant does not reread later Settings edits.
facts.failure_prefix: Sound/input/number-window failures precede or interrupt edits; successful assignments remain if a later refresh/input fails. No rollback or save is called by this editor.
facts.open: All prize consumers, native UI and arbitrary injected effect types remain separately scoped.

facts.meaning: TrainerBattleProperty.set builds MAX_PARTY_SIZE Pokemon property rows followed by8 item rows. Existing trainer editor reads that many Pokemon slots; rebuilding extracts only nonnil species entries in those slots and items at offset4+MAX_PARTY_SIZE. Config is read at each loop/offset expression. Validation rejects absent type/name/empty party. Register new hash precedes deleting changed old identity. Final Save changes yes saves registry then converts Trainer data; no reloads registry.
facts.control: The editor projects configured slots; it does not imply every source trainer has exactly that count. Property cancel returnsnil to break edit loop; outer modified flag includes earlier changes. Cancel/no-save reload only on normal final path, not a transaction around all intermediate changes. New trainer branch uses pbNewTrainer and its own returned party.
facts.failure_prefix: Registry writes/deletion and modified flag may precede save; save can complete before conversion failure. Exception before final load leaves earlier in-memory changes. No guaranteed all-or-nothing PBS/binary pair.
facts.open: Property widgets, pbNewTrainer and Writer/Trainer registry effects use their separately received contracts; no whole editor or all Trainer data qualification.

facts.meaning: pbTilesetScreen enters fade block, resizes to configured width and double height, forces scale1, creates/starts scene, then restores configured width/height and PokemonSystem screen size on normal return.
facts.control: Both screen dimensions are live reads at each call. This is temporary editor canvas sizing, not a second persisted game resolution setting.
facts.failure_prefix: There is no ensure in this method: failure after enlarged resize may skip local resize/scale restoration. Fade helper's independent cleanup does not itself prove this restoration.
facts.open: Native Graphics/scene implementation and outer caller recovery remain scoped separately.

facts.meaning: pbConnectionsEditor inside pbCriticalCode resizes configured dimensions by+288 each, scale1, creates MapScreen, runs mapScreen then loop then close, and restores base configured dimensions/current system scale only after those calls return.
facts.control: The wrapper receives this ordered block; this method has no ensure restoring dimensions. It does not mutate Settings resolution.
facts.failure_prefix: Earlier map edits/resize can survive error; close/restoration may be skipped by an exception. Native critical-code recovery is not inferred from the wrapper name.
facts.open: pbCriticalCode/native editor operations and map persistence require their own bounded facts.

facts.meaning: animationEditorMain viewport uses configured dimensions+288. pbAnimationEditor stops BGM, loads cached animations or creates missing first animation, resizes dimensions+288/scale1, invokes main, then restores configured dimensions/system scale and map autoplay. Main mutates animation/canvas through editing commands; BACK independently asks save (save_data to Data/PkmnAnimations.rxdata) and exit. Only accepted exit clears GameTemp animation cache and breaks; normal postloop disposes six windows/viewport then clears RPG cache.
facts.control: Save no does not undo prior in-memory edits; exit no can follow a successful save and continue editing. Save yes and exit yes are independent decisions. Config reads set viewport and Graphics sizes, not image resource dimensions.
facts.failure_prefix: BGM stop/cache load/resize/edit/save occur before normal cleanup. No ensure in either function; save may succeed before later failure, and exception can skip cache clear, disposal, resize or map autoplay. Other invoked editor tools are requests, not automatically accepted implementations.
facts.open: All import/export/timing/canvas implementations and native rendering/audio are separate; source file parent remains partial.

facts.meaning: Battle::Scene class body snapshots USE_ABILITY_SPLASH from MECHANICS_GENERATION>=5, NUM_BALLS from MAX_PARTY_SIZE, PLAYER_BASE_Y=height-80, FOE_BASE_X=width-128 and FOE_BASE_Y=height*3/4-112. Default configured values yield true,6,304,384,176 respectively. These declarations are evaluated at class loading and do not live-refresh on later setting reassignment.
facts.control: This receives declaration semantics and finite geometry/category roles only. It does not assert all Scene callers or all ability splash/party icon animation behavior has been received. Width512/height384/maxparty6/generation8 come from existing complete Settings producer.
facts.failure_prefix: Any earlier module/class load failure prevents reaching these constants; no save/UI action is committed by the expressions themselves.
facts.open: Use sites of these Scene constants and native presentation remain independently scoped; no whole Scene or whole battle visual PASS.

common_premise: Fixed R; ordinary Ruby constant evaluation/valid initialized editor state and default Settings producer already received. These are complete named necessary units/declarations actually read, with other full source reading credit retained only by its real reader.
persistence: Only the explicit Trainer and animation save branches request persistent writes. Other dimension/debug effect edits do not themselves call Game.save. Outer object save/reload uses the separately received SaveData contract; no native roundtrip is claimed.
remaining: 6 finite meanings receive25 original candidates. All unreceived downstream implementations are retained as bounded OPEN, not substituted with sourceFULL or whole domain acceptance.
